model.title: PEARL Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Ruben Gallego (D-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would require U.S. Customs and Border Protection to establish a pilot program that adopts dogs from local animal shelters and trains them as support dogs to help officers and staff cope with grief, trauma, and stress.
